notes.title: Challenges Update - Version 1.1.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938185/34a0f55a1a90a7236c72b38af80af6afa52eae6e.gif[/img]

[b]Introducting the Challenges update[/b]

Thank you all for your patience this year, it has finally paid off with the arrival of the newest update to Dungeon Deck! 

This update brings new ways to play Dungeon Deck. Choose from a list of challenging modifiers, and try to win the game! There are fun challenges such as Hot Potato, where cards can only stay in your hand for one round, or more difficult ones such as Boss Rush, where you have to beat all bosses in the game in a row!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938185/40444b227ee88ef88ef931cbf600fb2500146f0d.gif[/img]

Additionally, a new deck with new enemies and cards to unlock has been added! This is a rarer deck, so keep your eyes open when starting a new run!

Have fun!

[b]Change Log[/b]
[list]
[*]New main menu layout and art
[*]Challenge modes: Unlocked after completing main story
[*]New level event: Memory Box
[*]New Deck: Cryptid
[*]New cards: Bracer, Clippers, Knuckle Duster, Sponge Golem, Potion of Strength
[*]New visual indicators of low health
[*]Bug Fix: Can no longer sell infinite cards at the shop using a controller
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.10
notes.notes:
This update is another patch for various bugs that have been reported through the Discord:

[list]
[*] Bug Fix: Lion Bouncer will no longer stop empty plots from reducing move count on death
[*] Bug Fix: Attacking a Guilty Lizard with daggers no longer has the chance to summon multiple enemies
[*] Bug Fix: Makes discard hand behavior more predictable when rings are in your hand
[*] Bug Fix: Fixed several weapons not triggering ice and fire rings when attacking
[*] Bug Fix: Scabbard now properly ignores swords when drawing a new hand
[*] Bug Fix: Controllers can no longer ignore targeted enemies when there is only one targeted enemy
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.3
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Stops cardboard suit needing a summon to target
[*] No longer removes save states after small updates
[*] Kelp is automatically removed if no enemies remain
[*] Bug Fix: Choosing a card in lucky draw will no longer zoom in instead and not select
[*] Bug Fix: Daggers drawn from the discard can now be used in the same turn
[*] Bug Fix: Bone Club will no longer be accidentally duplicated
[*] Crash Fix: Clicking on a card while playing it can no longer crash the game
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.1
notes.notes:
A small patch to fix issues related to steam:
[list]
[*] Bug Fix: Steam Achievements will now unlock alongside in game achievements
[*] Bug Fix: Torn knife cards will no longer work infinitely
[*] Bug Fix: Stamped Bows now correctly calculate their damage
[*] Unlocks steam achievement for any already unlocked in-game achievement
[*] Shy Dagger: Bonus damage increased from 2 to 8
[*] Fixes text going off of some cards in Chinese translation
[/list]
